parts.text: Hello, what can you help me with?

Kai Ren should own it — procrastination sits in his domain of focus, dopamine, habits, and productivity, under the 'Focus, dopamine, productivity' pillar. (Marcus Voss is a defensible alternate if the angle is discipline and identity.)
